description: Test suite for authentication-related functions in the Mattermost server, including token parsing, password validation, MFA, LDAP authentication, and password migration.

methods.name: TestParseAuthTokenFromRequest
methods.description: Tests parsing of authentication tokens from HTTP requests, checking different header, cookie, and query string scenarios.

methods.name: TestCheckPasswordAndAllCriteria
methods.description: Tests password validation, MFA, and login attempt limits, including concurrent access scenarios.

methods.name: TestCheckLdapUserPasswordAndAllCriteria
methods.description: Tests LDAP user password validation, including mock LDAP login responses and login attempt limits.

methods.name: TestCheckLdapUserPasswordConcurrency
methods.description: Tests concurrent LDAP login attempts to ensure limits are enforced correctly under race conditions.

methods.name: TestCheckUserPassword
methods.description: Tests user password validation, including hash migration from bcrypt to PBKDF2, invalid passwords, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: TestMigratePassword
methods.description: Tests password migration logic from bcrypt to PBKDF2 hashes.
